slot_scores.name: min_weekly_production_A
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints or requirements not mentioned in the brief, such as minimum production levels, exclusivity between models, or additional resource limits?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked a broad catch-all that mentioned minimum production levels generally, and later asked whether the user-volunteered 10-unit Model A requirement was hard. It did not specifically ask for a lower bound on Model A before the user supplied it.

slot_scores.name: min_weekly_production_B

slot_scores.name: max_overtime_process_II
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you mention overtime in Process II, is there a separate overtime capacity limit beyond the 70 hours, or can overtime be used without any additional cap?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether there is an upper limit on overtime for Process II, and then confirmed it as a hard maximum.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the Model A and Model B minimum production requirements were only partially addressed through a vague catch-all and later confirmation of user-volunteered values, not through explicit questions about those lower bounds.

summary: The agent clarified the objective, hard capacity constraints, overtime limit, and profit interpretation well, but it recovered the Model A and Model B minimum production requirements only via a broad catch-all, leaving those P1 slots partially unresolved at READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
